blocks.text: A nested selector chooses an element inside another element. Less combines the outer and inner selectors for you.
Use Less 4 on your computer. Install Node.js first. Save examples as lesson.less, then run npx lessc lesson.less lesson.css. The browser loads lesson.css; this site does not build Less.
Read the code step by step

items: The outer rule gives the card padding.
The nested paragraph rule becomes `.card p`, so only paragraphs inside a card lose their margin.

blocks.text: The built CSS contains a .card p rule. It removes margins from paragraphs inside cards.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A nested p does not style every paragraph. Avoid many layers of nesting.
